prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production-ready 2D RTS animated sprite atlas for suppressorExosuit. Input image is a DESIGN REFERENCE ONLY. Preserve the unit's distinctive armor, silhouette, equipment and faction palette. REMOVE ALL card borders, labels, black backdrop and terrain. Generate entirely new individually painted ANIMATED poses, true transparent alpha.
Create EXACTLY 24 COLUMNS x 8 ROWS, a landscape sprite sheet about 2:1 aspect. Every column equal width, every row equal height. No outer margin, no text, no lines or labels. Every sprite stays within its own cell with clear padding. Same character scale and fixed ground anchor in every cell; do not translate or zoom sprites. Detailed hand-painted non-pixel science fiction, overhead/three-quarter viewpoint, top-lit readable silhouette.
Eight rows are eight genuinely different orientations, consistent throughout each row:
ROW1 N: north-facing BACK VIEW, show rear/backpack/engine, never face/cockpit front.
ROW2 NE: facing away/up-right, rear-right three-quarter.
ROW3 E: facing RIGHT, true right-side profile.
ROW4 SE: facing down-right, front-right three-quarter.
ROW5 S: facing viewer/down, FRONT VIEW.
ROW6 SW: facing down-left, front-left three-quarter.
ROW7 W: facing LEFT, true left-side profile.
ROW8 NW: facing away/up-left, rear-left three-quarter.
Use actual viewpoint changes, no mechanical mirroring of asymmetric weapons or equipment.
Within EACH row, exact column arrangement:
1-4 IDLE: 4 real breathing/scanning/mechanical/energy poses.
5-10 MOVE: 6 true articulated gait poses or moving wheel/tread/exhaust/control-flap cycles. Change limb/mechanical part poses; never merely shift or duplicate a static body.
11-15 ATTACK: 5 sequential weapon preparation, firing flash, physical recoil, follow-through, reset poses. Weapon direction matches that row.
16-17 HIT: 2 clearly different damage-flinch/spark reaction poses.
18-22 DEATH: 5 real progressive collapse/destruction frames: damaged body, breaking/falling, large disintegrating parts, lower ruined body, final small rubble. Large changed silhouette, distinct each direction. Mechanical vehicles break into smoking wreckage, humanoids collapse with shattered armor. No duplicated static units plus effects.
23-24 SPECIAL ABILITY: 2 distinctive activation frames appropriate for this unit.
Unit specifics: Very heavy human-sized gray-blue gold-trim armored exosuit with compact cyan visor, two large rotary arm cannons, segmented powered legs. Six articulated lumbering alternating steps with hip, knee and foot joint poses. Attack rotary cannons spin up, muzzle flash burst, arm recoil, hot barrel glow smoke, reset. Ability both barrels sweep outward in firing cone then concentrated suppression volley.
All 192 sprites required, all 8 correct directional rows and 24 columns. Include the entire sheet. No artistic scene, no UI, no printed words, no checkerboard. Transparent background. Keep effects contained in each cell.
